title: Proxy OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Transferable Relative Proxy Update for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.11505v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reward-based reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language models but incurs substantial costs when repeated across targets. On-policy distillation (OPD) reuses experts by matching their distributions on target-generated trajectories, yet differing base policies can confound reward-induced updates with pre-existing policy differences, potentially distorting transferred update directions. We propose Proxy OPD (P-OPD), a post-training method that transfers reward-induced relative policy updates using the target's frozen base policy as a reference. A proxy undergoes reward-guided exploration, yielding token-level log-probability changes between its initial and optimized policies. These signals guide learning on target-generated trajectories, with calibration controlling signal absorption, enabling reuse of reward-induced improvements across targets. translated_title: Proxy OPD：面向大语言模型的基于可迁移相对代理更新的在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 基于奖励的强化学习（RL）能够提升大语言模型的表现，但在多个目标上重复应用时会产生高昂成本。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在目标模型生成的轨迹上匹配专家模型的分布来复用专家模型，然而基础策略的差异可能使奖励诱导的更新与预先存在的策略差异相混淆，从而扭曲迁移的更新方向。我们提出 Proxy OPD（P-OPD），这是一种后训练方法，以目标模型冻结的基础策略作为参照来迁移奖励诱导的相对策略更新。一个代理模型在奖励引导下进行探索，产生其初始策略与优化策略之间的 token 级对数概率变化。这些信号用于指导在目标模型生成轨迹上的学习，并通过校准机制控制信号的吸收，从而实现奖励诱导改进在多个目标间的复用。在 Qwen3 系列模型上的实验覆盖了数学推理、代码生成等任务。
tldr: 提出Proxy OPD方法，以目标模型冻结的基础策略为参照来迁移奖励诱导的相对策略更新，避免不同基础策略间的差异干扰更新方向，从而实现专家模型的奖励改进在多个目标大模型间的高效低成本复用。
en_tdlr: Proxy OPD transfers reward-induced relative policy updates using the target's frozen base policy as a reference, avoiding confounding from differing base policies and enabling efficient reuse of expert improvements across multiple target LLMs.
